   "source": [
    ".. index:: Equations; Advection-Diffusion-Reaction\n",
    "\n",
    "# An Advection-Diffusion-Reaction System: Chemical Reaction Problem"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "5d79e398",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-06-12T21:34:32.339752Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-06-12T21:34:32.339584Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-06-12T21:34:34.366337Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-06-12T21:34:34.365616Z"
    },
    "lines_to_next_cell": 1
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "try:\n",
    "    import dune.femdg\n",
    "except ImportError:\n",
    "    print(\"This example needs 'dune.femdg' - skipping\")\n",
    "    import sys\n",
    "    sys.exit(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "import numpy\n",
    "from matplotlib import pyplot\n",
    "from ufl import *\n",
    "from dune.ufl import DirichletBC\n",
    "from dune.grid import structuredGrid\n",
    "from dune.fem.plotting import plotPointData as plot\n",
    "from dune.fem.space import lagrange, dgonb\n",
    "from dune.fem.scheme import galerkin\n",
    "from dune.femdg import femDGOperator\n",
    "from dune.femdg.rk import femdgStepper\n",
    "from dune.femdg import BndValue, BndFlux_v, BndFlux_c\n",
    "\n",
    "from dune.fem import threading\n",
    "threading.use = max(4,threading.max) # use at most 4 threads\n",
    "\n",
    "gridView = structuredGrid([0,0],[2*numpy.pi,2*numpy.pi],[20,20])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "44b7de45",
   "metadata": {
    "lines_to_next_cell": 0
   },
   "source": [
    "Method to compute the velocity based on a scalar elliptic equation"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "2a5c6323",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-06-12T21:34:34.368753Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-06-12T21:34:34.368468Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-06-12T21:34:34.372621Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-06-12T21:34:34.371787Z"
    },
    "lines_to_next_cell": 1
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def computeVelocity():\n",
    "    streamSpace = lagrange(gridView, order=1, dimRange=1)\n",
    "    Psi  = streamSpace.interpolate(0,name=\"streamFunction\")\n",
    "    u,v  = TrialFunction(streamSpace), TestFunction(streamSpace)\n",
    "    x    = SpatialCoordinate(streamSpace)\n",
    "    form = ( inner(grad(u),grad(v)) - 5*sin(x[0])*sin(x[1]) * v[0] ) * dx\n",
    "    streamScheme = galerkin([form == 0, DirichletBC(streamSpace,[0]) ])\n",
    "    streamScheme.solve(target=Psi)\n",
    "    return as_vector([-Psi[0].dx(1),Psi[0].dx(0)])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e73984e6",
   "metadata": {
    "lines_to_next_cell": 0
   },
   "source": [
    "Chemical reaction model"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "c54ab7f6",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-06-12T21:34:34.374184Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-06-12T21:34:34.374015Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-06-12T21:35:14.653869Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-06-12T21:35:14.653013Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/jpeg": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x1000 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "class Model:\n",
    "    transportVelocity = computeVelocity()\n",
    "    @classmethod\n",
    "    def S_e(cls,t,x,U,DU):\n",
    "        P1 = as_vector([0.2*pi,0.2*pi]) # midpoint of first source\n",
    "        P2 = as_vector([1.8*pi,1.8*pi]) # midpoint of second source\n",
    "        f1 = conditional(dot(x-P1,x-P1) < 0.2, 1, 0)\n",
    "        f2 = conditional(dot(x-P2,x-P2) < 0.2, 1, 0)\n",
    "        f  = conditional(t<5, as_vector([f1,f2,0]), as_vector([0,0,0]))\n",
    "        r = 10*as_vector([U[0]*U[1], U[0]*U[1], -2*U[0]*U[1]])\n",
    "        return f - r\n",
    "    @classmethod\n",
    "    def F_c(cls,t,x,U):\n",
    "        return as_matrix([ [*(Model.velocity(t,x,U)*u)] for u in U ])\n",
    "    @classmethod\n",
    "    def maxWaveSpeed(cls,t,x,U,n):\n",
    "        return abs(dot(Model.velocity(t,x,U),n))\n",
    "    @classmethod\n",
    "    def velocity(cls,t,x,U):\n",
    "        return Model.transportVelocity\n",
    "    @classmethod\n",
    "    def F_v(cls,t,x,U,DU):\n",
    "        return 0.02*DU\n",
    "    @classmethod\n",
    "    def physical(cls,t,x,U):\n",
    "        return conditional(U[0]>=0,1,0)*conditional(U[1]>=0,1,0)*\\\n",
    "               conditional(U[2]>=0,1,0)\n",
    "    boundary = {range(1,5): BndValue(as_vector([0,0,0]))}\n",
    "\n",
    "fig = pyplot.figure(figsize=(20,20))\n",
    "plot(Model.transportVelocity, gridView=gridView, gridLines=None, vectors=[0,1],figure=fig)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "d1866499",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Time evolution scheme"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "4bf5cc56",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-06-12T21:35:14.655616Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-06-12T21:35:14.655352Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-06-12T21:36:22.754978Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-06-12T21:36:22.754212Z"
    },
    "nbsphinx-thumbnail": {
     "tooltip": "A chemical reaction problem with three reactants."
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/jpeg": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1500x1500 with 9 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "space    = dgonb( gridView, order=3, dimRange=3)\n",
    "u_h      = space.interpolate([0,0,0], name='u_h')\n",
    "operator = femDGOperator(Model, space, limiter=\"scaling\")\n",
    "stepper  = femdgStepper(order=3, operator=operator)\n",
    "operator.applyLimiter(u_h)\n",
    "\n",
    "t        = 0\n",
    "saveTime = 1\n",
    "\n",
    "fig = pyplot.figure(figsize=(30,30))\n",
    "c = 0\n",
    "while t < 9:\n",
    "    operator.setTime(t)\n",
    "    t += stepper(u_h)\n",
    "    if t > saveTime:\n",
    "        saveTime += 1\n",
    "        u_h.plot(gridLines=None, figure=(fig, 331+c), colorbar=False)\n",
    "        c += 1"
   ]
  },
